title: A local bounded-above finite-free algebraic model of all derived fibre degrees
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] a pseudo-coherent complex [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and $x\in X$. There exist an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$, a commutative ring $A$, a homeomorphism $e:U\simeq\operatorname{Spec} A$, a complex $F$ of finite free $A$-modules, and an integer $b$, with $F^n=0$ for $n>b$, such that for every integer $j$ and every $z\in U$ the derived-fibre Betti number [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti] satisfies $\beta_j(E,z)=\dim_{\kappa(e(z))}H^j(F\otimes_A\kappa(e(z)))$. No lower bound on $F$ is asserted.

proof.text: At x use pseudo-coherence to obtain a bounded-above finite-free sheaf representative on an open neighbourhood. Shrink inside it to an affine open, restrict the complex and its derived isomorphism, and transport to Spec A. Open restriction preserves the free terms and upper bound. Apply affine_finiteFree_sheaf_complex_lift to obtain the bounded-above algebraic complex F, its finite-free terms and the associated-sheaf comparison.

Every finite-free term is flat. Apply the bounded-above flat derived-pullback comparison at each residue field, factoring through the open inclusion. Evaluation on the one-point residue spectrum computes homology, and the residue-field isomorphism of the affine chart transports its scalar action. Taking finrank gives the equality for every j and z, using the same F. The sheaf-to-open-scheme and scalar transports are the outstanding glue in this node.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_pseudoCoherent_fiber_boundedAbove_model (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPseudoCoherent X E) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (e : ↥(U : Set X) ≃ₜ PrimeSpectrum A)
        (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (b : ℤ),
        F.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Free A (F.X n) ∧ Module.Finite A (F.X n)) ∧
        ∀ (i : ℤ) (z : U), derivedFiberBetti X E i z =
          Module.finrank (e z).asIdeal.ResidueField
            ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars
              (algebraMap A (e z).asIdeal.ResidueField)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F).homology i)
